facts.fact: Sanu's birth name is Chandrika, a tailor's daughter of Pallikara by the river, sold at seven; Usha's birth name is Ushakumari, a potter's daughter from a hill village.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires the guards to hear their birth names at the reading

facts.fact: At the shelter, Kamalakshi asked Neela what stops a master writing a page again; Neela answered that Chathu never needed to.
facts.why: needed because the beat says Kamalakshi's question snaps into place

facts.fact: Usha's fresh crown-leaf page is dated and written the night before in the queen's hand with Usha as ledger number Four, and the queen leaves it and Chathu's forty fresh pages with Neela.
facts.why: needed so the queen's demonstration is a physical object and Neela can carry it north

facts.fact: The queen says a rider leaves the Salt Gate at dusk carrying the same offer (three hundred spears and Kettamala restored) to Devan, so he will have it before Neela does.
facts.why: needed to price Devan's office against Neela's answer and set up chapter 17

facts.fact: The queen says she has known of self-naming for nine days, since Usha told her what a burning ledger page means.
facts.why: needed so she can name the cost of self-naming in the offer scene
